summary: Harrison County, TX lookout described in 1958 as a 100-ft steel tower; FFLA lists the original as gone and a relocated tower standing at Winston Ranch, with no move date.

facts.status_note: Original site listed Tower Gone; a relocated tower is listed Standing at Winston Ranch, Nacogdoches County. No move date or mover in the sources read.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two lookout pages and one map record. No source links the 1958 or 1963 tower to the structure listed at Winston Ranch, so the story keeps the two sites apart. Child record us-tx-elysian-fields-at-winston-ranch (researched 2026-10-09) covers the same relocated tower; this parent story covers both sites. The directory spells the county Nacagdoches; Wikipedia spells it Nacogdoches. The agency name comes only from the survey page header, which does not state ownership. Two searches found nothing on the move date, the mover or the present condition. No photos found.
